item: P1 expected permission matrix (written BEFORE any v2 run)
source: Isomux worktree server/backends/opencode/supervisor.ts:42-77 (DEFAULT_OPENCODE_CONFIG), adapter.ts:115-124 (permissionMode bypassPermissions -> isomux-interactive-bypass when interactive, else isomux-cron; default mode -> no agent = default_agent build), safety-plugin-tool.ts:4. Unlisted actions take OpenCode 1.18.35 defaults, measured in pm-v1-effective-rules.json (GET /agent on v1 with this config).
note_on_brief: The task brief says cron 'allows shell/edit'. Today's code (supervisor.ts:66-75) gives isomux-cron bash:ask and edit:ask; Isomux applies bypass itself by answering the ask. The expectation below follows the code: ask. The brief's statement matches an older S6 probe config (oldharness s6-permission-probe.ts:189), not today's supervisor.ts.

build.question: deny
build.subagent: allow (v1 task falls to the * allow)

external_directory_rule: A read, write, or shell call that touches a path outside the session's directory must raise an ask (action external_directory) on all three agents.
hard_fail_if: v2 cannot express ask for shell or edit, or deny for question, on any of the three agents.
